abstract: To provide a gripping apparatus capable of gripping and carrying a griping object provided in a semiconductor factory like a probe card or a FOUP, and an autonomous mobile robot including the same.SOLUTION: A gripping apparatus 100 includes: a base part consisting of a frame, a plate, a box or a combination thereof; a number of first grippers 120 each of which includes a first terminal part 123 folded or bent correspondingly to a fitting groove 22, in which a separation distance between the first terminal parts is adjusted by the base part and which are provided while being opposed to each other; a number of second grippers 130 which are positioned outside of the first grippers, each of which includes a second terminal part 133 folded or bent toward an edge lower end of a gripping object 20, in which a separation distance between the second terminal parts is adjusted by the base part, and which are provided while being opposed to each other; an adjustment unit 150 which is provided in the base part and adjusts the separation distance between the first terminal parts in a number of first grippers and the separation distance between the second terminal parts in a number of second grippers; and a vertical drive unit which operates the adjustment unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2
source_title: GRIPPING APPARATUS AND AUTONOMOUS MOBILE ROBOT INCLUDING THE SAME

abstract: Systems and methods for collision detection and avoidance are provided. In one aspect, a robotic medical system includes a first robotic arm, an input device configured to receive one or more user inputs for controlling the first robotic arm, and a display configured to provide information related to the robotic medical system. The display includes a first icon that is representative of the first robotic arm and includes at least a first state and a second state. The robotic medical system also includes a processor and memory having stored thereon computer-executable instructions that cause the processor to control movement of the first robotic arm based on the one or more user inputs received at the input device in real time, determine a distance between the first robotic arm and a second component, and set the first icon to the first state or the second state based on the distance.
source_title: ROBOTIC MEDICAL SYSTEM WITH COLLISION PROXIMITY INDICATORS

abstract: A charging apparatus is configured to charge a mobile robot. The mobile robot is configured to emit an optical pattern. The charging apparatus includes a main body configured to perform charging of the mobile robot as the mobile robot docks with the charging apparatus, and two or more position markers located at the main body and spaced apart from each other. The position markers are configured to create indications distinguishable from a surrounding region when the optical pattern is emitted to surfaces of the position markers.
source_title: MOBILE ROBOT, CHARGING APPARATUS FOR THE MOBILE ROBOT, AND MOBILE ROBOT SYSTEM

abstract: A mobile robot system for automated operation of a data center or telecommunications office, includes a moveable robotic platform with a multiplicity of tools integrated therein, to operate on a network element within a bay, with integrated RFID (radio-frequency identification) tags and visual alignment markers attached to fiber optic connectors and ports of the network elements. The mobile robot system positions a robot probe arm with an RFID probe for proximity detection to identify a cable and associated fiber optic connector based on a unique RF identifier of a tag on the fiber optic connector. The robot probe arm has a connector gripper to engage and unplug the associated fiber optic connector.
source_title: AUTOMATED PHYSICAL NETWORK MANAGEMENT SYSTEM UTILIZING HIGH RESOLUTION RFID, OPTICAL SCANS AND MOBILE ROBOTIC ACTUATOR

abstract: The present invention relates to a safety device for a mobile robot for preventing an accident, and the present invention relates to a safety device capable of preventing an accident of a mobile robot by combining a primary safety device using a plurality of RGB-D cameras and a secondary safety device using a bumper. A safety device for a robot mounted on the robot, according to one aspect of the present invention, comprises: a primary safety device; and a secondary safety device connected to the primary safety device, wherein the primary safety device includes a plurality of RGB-D cameras that capture RGB (red, green, blue) and visual depth, and the secondary safety device includes: a bumper that absorbs a physical shock applied from the outside; and a contact sensor disposed on the exterior of the bumper. The plurality of RGB-D cameras are arranged to be spaced apart from each other at a predetermined distance such that a field of view can be adjusted so as to capture all directions of adjacent areas of the safety device for a robot, an occurrence of an event in a 3D space can be primarily detected on the basis of information obtained through the plurality of RGB-D cameras, and the occurrence of the event in the 3D space can be secondarily detected by using at least one of a displacement of the bumper and information sensed by the contact sensor.
source_title: SAFETY DEVICE FOR MOBILE ROBOT FOR PREVENTING ACCIDENT

abstract: A precision instrumentation platform carrying a tool, such as a scanner or drill, on a computer-controlled robotic arm is controlled by a robotic type positioning system. The scanner of the platform makes a three dimensional tomographic type scan of the area being diagnosed and a computer image is formed. A drill, or other treatment modality of the instrumentation platform, is controlled to treat the affected area. In the preferred embodiment of the invention, computer-controlled hydraulic pumps control vertical movement and rotation of the robotic arm and the instrumentation platform. These pumps adjust fluid volummes in various chambers to position the platform either for the purpose of making the scan or performing the treatment. As fluid volummes change, pistons move, and the platform follows a computer-directed path. Positional sensors, along with connecting torque systems and control systems create a multi-loop servo-system that guides the platform.
source_title: Computerized instrument platform positioning system

abstract: A device and method for sorting sample tubes, having a robotic assembly with a horizontal robotic arm which is configured to pivot around the base. The end of tooling arm is configured to pick up and hold a sample tube when a vacuum is applied and to deposit the sample tube into a designated slot in a tube rack when the vacuum is removed. The device includes a vacuum source to pull a vacuum through the tooling; an air source to expel air through the tooling; a horizontal stage underneath the robotic arm to hold a plurality of tube racks in a position; a vision system configured to record coded information on sample tubes and on the sides of tube racks in the device and to convey the coded information to a control system; and tube racks to store the sample tubes.
source_title: ROBOTIC SYSTEM FOR SORTING SAMPLE TUBES

abstract: Systems and methods for saturated robotic movement are provided. In one aspect, there is provided a robotic system, including a robotic arm configured to control movement of a medical instrument, and a processor configured to: receive a first user input from a user for moving the medical instrument with the robotic arm, determine that moving the robotic arm according to the first user input would cause a contact point of the robotic arm to contact or cross a collision boundary surrounding an object, and guide the movement of the robotic arm such that the contact point of the robotic arm continuously moves along the collision boundary based in part on the first user input, in response to the determination that moving the robotic arm according to the first user input would cause the contact point to contact or cross the collision boundary.
source_title: Systems and methods for saturated robotic movement

abstract: Disclosed are a mobile robot for serving and an operating method thereof. The mobile robot for serving, according to embodiments of the present invention, comprises: at least one tray arranged in an accommodation space of a body of the mobile robot and on which an object to be served is placed; a plurality of load cells arranged in the at least one tray; a driving unit arranged at the bottom of the body to move the mobile robot; and a control unit connected to communicate with the plurality of load cells and the driving unit. The control unit may determine, on the basis of sensing values sensed by the plurality of load cells, whether the object being served is placed on the at least one tray, and may change, on the basis of the determination, the moving speed of the mobile robot. Accordingly, when the mobile robot serves, the contents of the object being served can be stably delivered to an ordered customer without overflowing.
source_title: MOBILE ROBOT FOR SERVING AND OPERATING METHOD THEREOF

abstract: A robotic system for fueling or charging a vehicle having a vehicle connector, the robotic system including a robotic arm having a plurality of sequentially arranged articulated links and at least one group of operating cables extending from a proximal end of the arm to terminate at a control link, for controlling the position of that link, the cables each having a path comprising a passage in each successive more proximal link for closely receiving the cable, a flexible conduit operably connected with the robotic arm for delivering a fluid or an electrical current, respectively, to a vehicle, the conduit being connected to a source at a first end and a delivery connector at a second end, and a control system for operating the robotic arm and the hose or cable, wherein the control system directs the robotic arm to engage the vehicle connector with the delivery connector and, upon engagement of the vehicle connector and delivery connector, the control system relaxes the robotic arm to an under-constrained condition.
source_title: ROBOTIC SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR VEHICLE FUELING AND CHARGING

abstract: A robotic system includes a robotic arm, a base couple coupled to the robotic arm, and a controller. The robotic supports a work implement and is configured to move the work implement to perform an operation on a workpiece. The base is configured to be removably coupled to a mounting surface. The controller is in communication with the robotic arm, the work implement, and the base. Further, the controller is configured to disable the operation of at least one of the robotic arm and the work implement if a coupling parameter between the base and the mounting surface is below a threshold value.
source_title: Robotic system

abstract: A system for enabling a mobile robot to utilize an elevator autonomously comprises a pressing module including at least one pressing finger adapted to press elevator call buttons on an elevator call control panel. A lifting device of the system supports the pressing module and selectively adjusts a height position of the pressing module for aligning the at least one pressing finger on the pressing module to height positions horizontally aligned with the elevator call buttons. A controller wirelessly communicates with the mobile robot and the pressing module. In response to a command sent by the mobile robot, the controller instructs the pressing module to press an elevator call button on the elevator call control panel associated with the command.
source_title: System and Method of Enabling a Mobile Robot to Take an Elevator Autonomously

abstract: A safety control apparatus (100) for a tool changing device of a robotic arm is described, said apparatus being configured to allow the decoupling or the coupling between robotic arm (5) and tool (6) safely. The safety control apparatus comprises:- a first module (101) associated with the robotic arm,- a second module (102) associated with the tool and comprising storage means (110) in which at least one safety signal (S, UID, PR) is stored,- means (103) associated with a tool parking station (30) adapted to prevent or allow the activation of said second module, said second module, once activated, being configured to wirelessly transmit said at least one safety signal to the first module, said first module being configured to allow the decoupling or the coupling between robotic arm and tool in response to the reception of said at least one safety signal.
source_title: SAFETY CONTROL APPARATUS FOR TOOL CHANGING DEVICE OF A ROBOTIC ARM

abstract: Provided is an information processing device which processes information on a path of a mobile robot. The information processing device comprises a management unit which manages path information for each path including posture stability information when the mobile robot has travelled through the path. The posture stability information includes at least one of the variance of the position of the center of gravity and the variance of the posture during the travel of the mobile robot on the path. Moreover, the posture stability information includes a CoP control amount formed from a deviation between a measured value and target CoP for the mobile robot to which walking control is applied on the basis of ZMP. Moreover, the posture stability information further includes a landing position correction amount formed from an error between a measured value and a planned landing point for the mobile robot walking with a plurality of legs.
source_title: INFORMATION PROCESSING DEVICE, INFORMATION PROCESSING METHOD, COMPUTER PROGRAM, AND MOBILE ROBOT

abstract: PURPOSE: A mobile robot, a terminal device, a remote control system of the mobile robot, and a method thereof are provided to monitor surroundings around the mobile robot in remote sites and to rapidly respond to a state of the mobile robot by checking the state in real time. CONSTITUTION: A mobile robot comprises a communicating unit and a controlling unit. The communicating unit receives a control signal from a terminal device and transmits an answering signal corresponding to the control signal. The controlling unit controls the mobile robot according to the control signal and generates the answering signal according to a control result. The controlling unit extracts a charging command from the control signal and moves the mobile robot to a charging station according to the charging command. [Reference numerals] (AA) Mobile robot; (BB) Terminal device; (S110) Inputting a charging command; (S120) Generating a control signal; (S130) Control signal; (S140) Extracting the charging command; (S150) Moving to a charging station; (S160) Response signal; (S170) Generating a control screen; (S180) Displaying the control screen; (S190) Charging
source_title: MOBILE ROBOT, TERMINAL, AND SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR REMOTELY CONTROLLING THE ROBOT

abstract: The present disclosure relates to a mobile robot system comprising a docking station having a platform having a front and a rear, first and second raised charging contacts on the platform and first and second ramp features on the platform. The mobile robot includes a housing, a motorized drive system connected to the housing, first and second charging contacts on a bottom of the housing and a cleaning module that extends below the bottom of the housing. The mobile robot is movable from an approach position with the robot spaced apart from the front of the platform to a docked position with the mobile robot on the platform and the docking station charging contacts engaged with the mobile robot charging contacts. As the robot moves from to the docked position, the robot engages the first and second ramp features and the cleaning module is lifted over the docking station charging contacts.
source_title: MOBILE ROBOT DOCKING SYSTEMS AND METHODS

abstract: A mobile robot according to the present invention comprises: a traveling unit which moves a main body; a sensing unit which detects surrounding objects during traveling; a communication module into which information is input or received and which outputs or transmits information; and a control unit which effects control so as to screen for objects while traveling through a region specified by region information input or received from the communication module and effects control so as to output or transmit identification information and positional information of detected found objects, through the communication module. A control method for the mobile robot according to the present invention comprises: an input step of receiving input of region information for traveling; a traveling step of screening for objects while traveling through the region specified by the region information; and an output step of outputting identification information and positional information of found objects detected in the traveling step.
source_title: MOBILE ROBOT AND CONTROL METHOD FOR MOBILE ROBOT

abstract: The present invention relates to a mobile robot and a control method thereof. The mobile robot according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises: a main body; a driving unit that moves the main body; a sensing unit that is installed on the main body and includes at least one sensor that detects data corresponding to a state of the main body; and a control unit that controls the driving unit based on the data detected by the sensing unit. When the main body is driven in a first direction, the control unit may determine a state for the first direction based on first data corresponding to the first direction detected by the sensing unit, and when the main body is driven in a second direction intersecting the first direction, the control unit may determine a state for the second direction based on second data corresponding to the second direction detected by the sensing unit, and determine a main direction of travel of the main body by comparing the first state and the second state.
source_title: MOVING ROBOT AND CONTROLLING METHOD FOR THE MOVING ROBOT

abstract: The invention provides a wheel-foot conversion type mobile robot system, relating to mobile robots. The wheel-foot conversion type mobile robot system is used for solving the problems that the obstacle avoidance ability of the existing wheeled robots is poor and the walking speed of the existing footed robots is low. According to the wheel-foot conversion type mobile robot system, one end of each central axle is fixedly connected and is axially locked through a corresponding first limiting block, a shoulder is arranged at the other end of each central axle, a spring sleeves each central axle and is located between a corresponding bearing and the corresponding shoulder, a central blind hole is formed in the other end of each central axle, and a first key groove is formed in each central blind hole; semi-annular grooves are formed in fixed half wheels along the circumferential direction, movable half wheels and the fixed half wheels are in turning connection relatively to the central axles, complete wheels are formed by the fixed half wheels and the movable half wheels during the conversion to a wheeled state, the movable half wheels are turned into the semi-annular grooves of the fixed half wheels during the conversion to a footed state, and single scrolls are mounted on the central axles. The wheel-foot conversion type mobile robot system belongs to the field of the mobile robots.
source_title: Wheel-foot conversion type mobile robot system

abstract: A calibration method for robotic arm system is provided and is used in a computing device. The method includes: receiving an image of a correction object fixed to a front end of a robotic arm by a visual device, wherein a pedestal of the robotic arm has a pedestal coordinate system, and the front end of the robotic arm has a first relative relationship with the pedestal, and the front end of the robotic arm has a second relative relationship with the correction object; obtaining three-dimensional feature data of the correction object according to the image; and computing a third relative relationship between the visual device and the pedestal of the robotic arm according to the three-dimensional feature data, the first relative relationship and the second relative relationship to correct error between the robotic arm and the visual device.
source_title: Calibration method and device for robotic arm system

abstract: The invention provides a robot control system, a robot control method, and a storage medium. A robot control system according to the present embodiment is a robot control system for controlling a mobile robot configured to autonomously move within a facility. When one or more used pallets of a plurality of pallets for catering services within the facility are detected to be returned to a first designated location, the system instructs the mobile robot to collect the pallets returned to the first designated location and deliver the pallets to a second designated location.
source_title: Robot control system, robot control method, and storage medium

abstract: A mobile robot system and method for determining the stiffness of a human arm while moving with a user during overground interaction as the user holds the robot's handle and exchanges forces with it. A mobile base moves with the user, a robot arm interacts with the user, and a controller determines the stiffness. The robot arm includes servomotors driving a linkage mechanism, an end effector including the handle supported by the linkage mechanism, and a force transducer measuring a force applied by the user to the handle. The controller causes the robot arm to generate a force perturbation at the handle, measure a peak velocity achieved by the human arm, determine the stiffness of the human arm as a function of force and displacement, and control operation of the system based on the determined stiffness. A robot body may allow for adjusting the height of the robot arm.
source_title: Mobile robot configured to determine human arm stiffness during overground interaction

abstract: The invention discloses a wheel-track-leg combined type mobile robot which comprises a chassis, and a track mechanism, a wheel type mechanism and a form switching mechanism are arranged on the chassis. The form switching mechanism comprises swing arm motors installed at the four corners of the chassis, and an output shaft of each swing arm motor is fixedly connected with a crawler mechanism through a transmission mechanism. The robot is high in form switching speed, obviously improved in terrain adaptability, outstanding in obstacle crossing ability, low in energy consumption and obviously improved in maneuverability, independent pure crawler-type movement, independent pure wheel type movement and independent leg type movement can be achieved, energy consumption is reduced, and meanwhile, different working modes are switched, so that the robot is high in adaptability to the terrain, high in obstacle crossing ability and low in energy consumption. The robot has the advantages of mobile robots in various forms, is suitable for serving as an exploration robot to complete exploration work or reconnaissance work, and can draw terrain work by additionally arranging a camera, a plotter and the like.
source_title: Wheel-track-leg combined type mobile robot

abstract: The invention relates to a robotic device (2) for positioning a surgical instrument relative to the body (C1) of a patient. Said device includes a first robotic arm (35) provided, on one end, with a means for rigidly connecting to at least one surgical instrument such as to hold, move, position, and guide said surgical instrument, means for anatomical realignment of said first arm relative to said body (1), said realignment being carried out by realigning an image that is of an area of the anatomy of said patient and acquired peroperatively in relation to imaging previously acquired from sensors for real-time detection of the inner movements of said anatomical area, and means for compensating the movements of said first arm on the basis of said detected movements. One such device is characterized in that said device includes at least one second robotic arm (4) provided to one end of said sensors for detecting said inner movements of the anatomical area, said detection sensors being positioned onto said contact of said anatomical area, and means for controlling the positioning of said first arm (3) relative to said sensed inner movements and moreover relative to the outer movements induced in said second arm (4).
source_title: ROBOTIC-ASSISTED DEVICE FOR POSITIONING A SURGICAL INSTRUMENT RELATIVE TO THE BODY OF A PATIENT

abstract: In general terms, the present invention provides a passively compliant robotic arm having one or more variable stiffness joints controllable by first and second bi-directional actuators that can be independently operated. Each bi-directional actuator may be operable in a first configuration to urge the joint in a first direction, and in a second configuration to urge the joint in a second direction opposite to the first direction. The bi-directional actuators may be operated in a cooperating mode (high torque mode) in which they work in tandem (i.e. both in the first configuration or second configuration) to double the available torque output. The bi-directional actuators may also (or alternatively) be operated in a high stiffness mode (antagonist mode) in which they counter-act each other by operating so that they oppose one another (i.e. one in the first configuration and the other in the second configuration). The high torque mode may be utilised for an initial portion of a movement trajectory, and the antagonist mode for a final portion of the movement trajectory. The relatively high stiffness in the high stiffness/antagonist mode results from the combined effects of the non-linear force-deflection relationship of the first and second resilient members. The resilient members may each comprise an elastic element, tendon or other resilient member that can be stretched (elongated) to increase tension therein and thereby urge the joint to move.
source_title: ROBOTIC ARM

abstract: A mobile robot location method is provided to locate the position of a mobile robot accurately by using MUSIC(Multiple Signal Classification) algorithm. A mobile robot location method comprises a step of transmitting a location request signal to a mobile robot through a first antenna(111), a step of receiving response signals transmitted in response to the location request signal through the first antenna and a second antenna composed of array antennas(113a,113b,113c), a step of estimating the distance to the mobile robot based on the response signal received through the first antenna, and a step of predicting the direction of the mobile robot based on the response signal received through the second antenna.
source_title: Mobile Robot Location Method

abstract: PURPOSE: A mobile robot for following human workers is provided to prevent an accident by efficiently checking the distance between a robot main body and an operator through a robot sensor unit. CONSTITUTION: A mobile robot for following human workers comprises a robot main body. The robot main body comprises a robot sensor unit(110), a robot control unit(120) and a robot driving unit(130). The robot sensor unit senses an object. In case an object is an operator, the robot sensor unit checks the distance between the operator and robot main body. The robot control unit receives a sensor signal of the robot sensor unit, controls the distance from an operator and maintains a fixed distance from the operator. The robot driving unit goes forward or back through the control signal offered from the robot control unit.
source_title: Human Worker Following Mobile Robot

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots and particularly relates to a mobile robot based on ultrahigh frequency radio location. The mobile robot comprises an ultrahigh frequency radio location module, an ultrasonic obstacle avoidance module, a remote control module, a movement control module and a central control device, wherein the ultrahigh frequency radio location module is composed of at least three ranging base stations and at least one mobile tag; the ultrasonic obstacle avoidance module is composed of an ultrasonic probe and an ultrasonic driving unit; the remote control module is composed of a remote control unit and a master control receiving unit; and the movement control module is composed of a motor drive and a motor. The mobile robot based on ultrahigh frequency radio location disclosed by the invention performs following control based on ultrahigh frequency radio location and has the advantages that the cost is low, the location update frequency is fast and omnidirectional location at 360 degrees can be realized. In addition to precise motor motion control, the mobile robot can realize followed and associated movement control in various application scenes.
source_title: Mobile robot based on ultrahigh frequency radio location

abstract: The invention discloses an agricultural mobile robot autonomous navigation method for fruit picking, and the method employs a DBSCAN method and a fruit cluster splitting method to plan a parking point, thereby enabling screened fruits to fall into a range with the obtained parking point as a circle center and a picking range threshold as a radius. By means of the method, the agricultural mobile robot can efficiently pick the screened fruits by traversing the parking points, the phenomenon that picking is conducted while walking in the prior art is avoided, and due to the fact that the driving path and the starting and stopping frequency are reduced, the picking efficiency of the agricultural robot is improved, and meanwhile energy consumption is reduced.
source_title: Agricultural mobile robot autonomous navigation method for fruit picking

abstract: The invention discloses an obstacle avoidance method combining a simulated annealing genetic algorithm and an improved artificial potential field method, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a grid map of an environment, and determining an obstacle grid and a passable grid; performing global path planning based on a genetic simulated annealing algorithm to obtain a global planning path; and according to the global planning path, moving in a resultant potential field of an improved repulsive potential energy function. The method further comprises the following steps: detecting whether a local minimum point is trapped; if yes, introducing a filling potential field; and if not, continuing to move along the global planning path until the target point is reached. According to the method, the traditional genetic algorithm is introduced into the simulated annealing thought, the optimal path planning can be faster, the global optimal solution can be obtained more easily, the improved artificial potential field method is fused on the basis of the genetic simulated annealing algorithm, and the two methods make the best of each other, so that the probability that the mobile robot falls into the local minimum point is effectively reduced, and the optimal path planning speed is improved. And the robot can reach the target point more safely.
source_title: Obstacle avoidance method combining simulated annealing genetic algorithm and improved artificial potential field method

abstract: A robotic tool changer removably attaches a robotic tool to a robotic arm. The changer includes a tool module connected to the robotic tool, and a master module connected to the robotic arm. To attach and detach the robotic tool, the changer couples and uncouples the tool module and the master module. A master electrical signal module (ESM) affixes to the master module and a tool ESM affixes to the tool module. In accordance with design requirements, the changer applies the same power supply to both the master ESM and the tool ESM. The changer, however, selectively suppresses application of the power supply to the tool ESM, while maintaining application of the power supply to the master ESM, during the coupling or uncoupling of the master module and the tool module. In doing so, the changer enables such coupling and uncoupling, while also preventing the formation of transient electric arcs.
source_title: Power control of a robotic tool changer

abstract: PURPOSE: A mobile robot equipping an obstacle detection sensor for improving the efficiency or the accuracy of an obstacle detection sensor is provided to sense the obstacle of various forms with small number of obstacle detection sensor. CONSTITUTION: A mobile robot equipping an obstacle detection sensor for improving the efficiency or the accuracy of an obstacle detection sensor includes a main body(100), a driving unit(200), a obstacle detection sensor(310), and a controller. The driving unit moves the main body. The obstacle detection sensor is installed in the progressive direction of the main body. The controller operates the driving unit based on data for measuring the data from the obstacle detection sensor.
source_title: MOBILE ROBOT WITH SENSOR FOR DETECTING OBSTACLE

abstract: A measurement system for positioning accuracy of a robotic arm includes the robotic arm, a computing device, a robotic arm controlling device, a first magnetic element and a second magnetic element. The robotic arm controlling device is electrically connected to the robotic arm and the computing device. The first magnetic element is disposed on a robotic arm. The second magnetic element is disposed on a fixed platform. One of the first magnetic element and the second magnetic element is electrically connected to the computing device. The robotic arm controlling device controls the robotic arm to move the first magnetic element above the second magnetic element to generate a magnetic field. The computing device is configured to calculate a plurality of movement error information of the first magnetic element in the magnetic field, and count the plurality of movement error information to obtain a positioning accuracy of the robot arm.
source_title: Measurement system and method for positioning accuracy of a robotic arm

abstract: An end effector (100, figure 1) for attachment to a robotic arm (300, figure 4a) has an interface end configured to receive and retain a control section of an endoscope 200. First (111, figure 1) and second (112) sockets engage with two angulation control knobs on the endoscope whilst linear actuators 113 are provided to operate buttons or valves. A cavity (114) is shaped to accommodate the endoscope, having perpendicular channels (116, 117) to receive the insertion portion and the umbilical. A releasable catch 115 may secure the endoscope. The interface end may be covered by a housing (110). A body of the end effector is positioned between the interface end and the robotic arm and may comprise a two-piece housing 120 containing two rotary actuators (121, 122) driving gear wheels 121a and 122a. These in turn are coupled to larger gear wheels 112a and 131 which rotate the first and second sockets. The robot arm may be part of a force-limited collaborative robot with torque sensors.
source_title: Appartus for remote operation of an endoscopy device

abstract: A system for controlling locomotion of a mobile robot such as a legged walking robot in a working space, comprises a line or array of optical detectors (382) on opposite sides of a foot (22L, 22R) of the robot, and a landmark (80) of a line or an arc provided in the working space which defines a region having different attributes, e.g. a difference in brightness, from the surrounding space. The optical detectors (382) generate different signals depending on the brightness to give a relative position of the robot to the landmark (80). When the landmark is an arc, its center is located in line with work for the robot, and a relative direction of the robot to the landmark (80) or the work can be determined. Using these systems, locomotion of the robot may be controlled so that the robot can stably ascend/descent stairs or spiral staircases. <IMAGE>
source_title: System for detecting position of mobile robot and controlling the same

abstract: The present disclosure relates to a plurality of autonomous mobile robots. A plurality of autonomous mobile robots comprise a first mobile robot including an antenna configured to transmit and receive signals, and a second mobile robot including a first antenna and a second antenna disposed on a front area of a main body thereof to transmit and receive signals to and from the antenna of the first mobile robot. The second mobile robot comprises a control unit configured to determine a relative position of the first mobile robot using the signal received by the first antenna and the second antenna.
source_title: Plurality of autonomous mobile robots and controlling method for the same

abstract: An airport baggage recording system is provided. The system (100) has a telescopic robotic arm (101) that loads airport baggage. The robotic arm (101) has one end connected to an upright (102) by a pivot (104) and a second end connected to a disc (103). A radio frequency identification (RFID) reader (105) is located in the disc (103) that reads RFID tags on the airport baggage when the airport baggage is placed on the disc (103) during loading. Another RFID reader (105) is located on the pivot (104) that reads the RFID tags on the airport baggage when the airport baggage is placed on the disc (103) during loading. The RFID reader (105) in the disc (103) and the RFID reader (105) on the pivot (104) both read the RFID tags on the airport baggage to prevent errors in reading the RFID tags on the airport baggage during loading.
source_title: BAGGAGE RECORDING SYSTEM

abstract: A track-leg and foot hybrid mobile robot comprises a track traveling unit, auxiliary thigh obstacle-crossing units are mounted on two sides of the front and the rear of the track traveling unit respectively, and an auxiliary shank obstacle-crossing unit is connected to every auxiliary thigh obstacle-crossing unit. In a conventional track traveling mode, thighs can assist in obstacle crossing and are extended to cross low obstacles but shanks can be put away through contraction; a shank participation mode can be changed into a four-foot movement mode. Both the thighs and the shanks on two sides are driven by independent power systems and can swing independently under control of a control system so as to assist in obstacle crossing or traveling like four feet. The track-leg and foot hybrid mobile robot has the advantages that the thighs and the shanks are added on the basis of a conventional tracked robot, and the track-leg and foot hybrid mobile robot can travel in a traditional track mode and can cross the obstacles with the aid of the four-foot mode, so that a steady traveling speed and energy efficiency of the tracked robot are maintained, and high trafficability of a footed robot is enhanced.
source_title: Track-leg and foot hybrid mobile robot

abstract: The invention discloses an obstacle detection method and device, a storage medium and a mobile robot. The obstacle detection method specifically comprises the steps that an advancing area image shot by a declination camera device installed on an AGV is acquired; determining the lower part in the advancing area image as a reference area; determining the rest part above the reference area in the advancing area image as a detection area; detecting an object region and a shadow region in the detection region; when it is detected that the object area and the shadow area exist in the detection areaat the same time, whether the position relation between the object area and the shadow area is matched with the light projection direction or not is detected; and when the position relationship between the object area and the shadow area is matched with the light projection direction, marking the object area as a suspected obstacle. According to the embodiment of the invention, the position information of the three-dimensional obstacle is efficiently judged by analyzing the acquired advancing area image, so that a large amount of data is prevented from being used for calculation or training, and relatively high calculation efficiency is realized.
source_title: Obstacle detection method and device, storage medium and mobile robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a mobile robot and a control method thereof. The mobile robot according to an embodiment of the present specification comprises: a body forming an appearance; a drive unit for moving the body; and a control unit obtaining map information for a work area, determining a driving route through learning based on the work map information and work information on the map, and controlling the drive unit to perform work in the work area along the driving route. The work information includes work time information corresponding to a specific driving route. The control unit determines the driving route through reinforcement learning which gives a reward in response to a decrease in a working time based on the work time information. An objective of the present invention is to provide the control method for providing a user with area information about the acquired work area, and the mobile robot using the same.
source_title: Mobile robot and control method thereof

abstract: In the control of legged mobile robot, a desired walking pattern (gait) is usually preestablished supposing a floor such that the robot walks on the floor. However, if a floor on which the robot walks actually is not the same as the supposed floor so that there is an angular therebetween, floor reaction force is not the same as that desired, causing the locomotion stable. Therefore, the error is estimated and the desired walking pattern is corrected in response to the error such that the floor reaction force becomes as desired. Namely, the robot's possible floor contact portion's position is firstly calculated on the assumption that the robot does not exhibit any compliance behavior including mechanical deformation intrinsically assigned thereto and a plane which wholly or partly includes or has the possible floor contact portion's position, is presumed. Then an angle formed by the virtual plane and the supposed floor is presumed. And floor reaction force is controlled through the angle and the desired walking pattern is corrected such that floor reaction force becomes as desired. The error is similarly used to correct output of an inclinometer equipped on the robot.
source_title: System for controlling locomotion of legged mobile robot and correcting inclinometer's output thereof

abstract: A mobile robot is configured for operation in a commercial or industrial setting, such as an office building or retail store. The robot can patrol one or more routes within a building, and can detect violations of security policies by objects, building infrastructure and security systems, or individuals. In response to the detected violations, the robot can perform one or more security operations. The robot can include a removable fabric panel, enabling sensors within the robot body to capture signals that propagate through the fabric. In addition, the robot can scan RFID tags of objects within an area, for instance coupled to store inventory. Likewise, the robot can generate or update one or more semantic maps for use by the robot in navigating an area and for measuring compliance with security policies.
source_title: Latency control in human operated mobile robot

abstract: The invention discloses a vision-based loopback detection method, and the method comprises the steps: detecting whether a current moving path accords with a loopback detection triggering condition or not at a mobile robot side in the moving process of a mobile robot, and triggering the current loopback detection under the condition that the current moving path accords with the loopback detection triggering condition, the current position information is recorded as current loopback detection trigger point information, and loopback detection trigger conditions at least comprise one of the following conditions: a current moving path is overlapped with a historical path of a finished moving path before the current moving path; the angle of the current moving direction deviating from the historical path direction adjacent to the current moving direction is larger than a set angle threshold value, the accumulated length of the moving path is larger than a set accumulated length threshold value, and the position distance between the current loopback detection trigger point and the historical loopback detection trigger point is not smaller than a set first distance threshold value. According to the invention, the calculation power consumption is reduced, and the detection rate of effective loopback is improved.
source_title: Vision-based loopback detection method and device, and mobile robot

abstract: The invention discloses a non-stop control method and system for a mobile robot, and belongs to the technical field of mobile robot control. The mobile robot comprises a mobile platform and a multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm. The method comprises the steps of: controlling the speed of the tail end of the multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm to be a speed according to a control rate for motion based on the speed control rate of an executor at the tail end of the multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm; based on the speed control rate of the mobile platform, controlling the relative poseof the mobile platform and an object; and taking the speed of the mobile platform as a control quantity, and adopting a feedforward control compensation mode to eliminate the motion component of the tail end of the multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm caused by the motion of the mobile platform. The advantages of feedforward control and feedback control are combined, the influence of movement ofthe mobile platform on movement of the tail end of the mechanical arm is reduced, and non-stop operation of the mobile robot can be achieved.
source_title: Non-stop control method and system for mobile robot

abstract: PURPOSE: A mobile robot, a remote control system of a mobile robot, and a method thereof are provided to allow a user to remotely watch the surroundings around the mobile robot and to rapidly obtain a state of the mobile robot by checking the state in real time. CONSTITUTION: A mobile robot comprises a storing unit, a communicating unit, and a control unit. The storage unit stores a control program driving the mobile robot. The communicating unit receives a control signal from an external terminal device and transmits update information of a control program to the terminal device. The control unit extracts an update command from the control signal and updates the control program according to the update command. [Reference numerals] (AA) Robot cleaner; (BB) Terminal device; (CC) No; (DD) Yes; (S10) Requesting connection; (S110) Update is required?; (S120) Finishing connection; (S130) Accessing a server; (S140) Update; (S150) Confirming connection; (S160) Generating a control screen; (S170) Displaying the control screen; (S180) Control signal; (S190) Executing a control command; (S20) Authentication; (S30) Confirming connection; (S40) Displaying an initial control screen
source_title: MOBILE ROBOT, AND SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR REMOTELY CONTROLLING THE SAME

abstract: The invention provides a control method, device, equipment and system of a movable robot and a medium, and relates to the technical field of logistics transportation, at least one visual sensor is deployed in a working area of the movable robot, and a scannable area of the at least one visual sensor at least covers the working area. The method comprises the steps that in the process that the movable robot executes a task in a working area, a virtual electronic fence is generated under the condition that it is determined that at least one target object exists based on sensor information obtained by at least one visual sensor; the target object is an abnormal object which hinders the mobile robot from executing a task; the walking path of the mobile robot is planned based on the position information of the virtual electronic fence, the mobile robot is controlled to execute tasks based on the walking path, the visual sensors are intensively deployed in the working area for real-time detection of the working area, the hardware cost is reduced, the path is dynamically planned based on the detection result, and the working efficiency is improved. And the flexibility and adaptability of the robot are improved.
source_title: Mobile robot control method, device, equipment, system and medium

abstract: The inventive concept is based on the inventors' realization that by providing a sorting device for a robotic system that has two tubes being telescopically arranged and resiliently separated with a springing means, the picking and releasing of heavy objects may be improved. The inventive concept includes a method and system for conducting the sorting with a robotic arm and suction gripping system.
source_title: ROBOTIC SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR SORTING WASTE WITH SUCTION GRIPPER

abstract: The present invention provides a control device for a mobile robot. While a mobile robot 1 is in a predetermined motion state, if a load evaluation amount, which is either the magnitude of a load detected on a particular joint or an estimated temperature value of a joint actuator for driving the joint, exceeds a predetermined threshold value, then a desired displacement amount of each joint of the mobile robot 1 is determined with a requirement that the load evaluation amount remains to be the threshold value or less, and the joint actuator is controlled on the basis of the determined desired displacement amount.
source_title: Control device for mobile robot

abstract: The invention relates to the field of wheel-foot type robots, in particular to a four-foot wheel type deformable omni-directional mobile robot with multiple advancing modes and a control method thereof. The overall structure of the four-foot wheel type deformable omni-directional robot is composed of a vehicle body, a first leg-foot branch chain, a second leg-foot branch chain, a third leg-foot branch chain and a fourth leg-foot branch chain, and the four-foot wheel type deformable omni-directional robot can be freely switched between a normal foot type robot and a wheel type robot in real time by controlling the rotating angle of a motor, so the four-foot wheel type deformable omni-directional robot has the high moving speed of wheel type movement and the high complex environment adaptability of foot type movement; meanwhile, the front side, the back side, the front side, the back side, the left side and the right side are not distinguished, so the stability and the omnibearing moving capability are further improved, and the wheel type deformable omni-directional robot has wide social application prospects.
source_title: Four-foot wheel type deformable omni-directional mobile robot and control method thereof

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of mobile robot path planning, and particularly relates to a mobile robot path planning method based on an improved pelican optimization algorithm, and the improved pelican optimization algorithm path planning in the method comprises the following steps: constructing a grid map to simulate a robot working environment, initializing a pelican population by adopting Logistic chaotic mapping in an initialization stage, and carrying out Pelican optimization; the diversity and distribution uniformity of the population are enhanced, so that the global search capability of the algorithm is improved; in the exploration stage, a sine and cosine optimization algorithm and a nonlinear inertia weight coefficient are combined to improve the diversity and convergence speed of algorithm search; a level flight strategy is introduced in a development stage to further improve the ability of the algorithm to jump out of a local optimal solution and maintain enough global search ability in the later stage of the algorithm. Simulation results show that the improved algorithm can quickly find an optimal path.
source_title: Mobile robot path planning method based on improved pelican optimization algorithm

abstract: PURPOSE: A docking system and method for a mobile robot is provided to quickly and precisely dock the mobile robot with a charging unit by compensating the position of the mobile robot in real time. CONSTITUTION: A docking system for a mobile robot is composed of a charging unit(100), and the mobile robot(200). The charging unit includes an infrared transmitting port(1), and an infrared receiving port(2). The infrared transmitting port transmits position basis data and guide data for guiding the mobile robot into the charging unit. The infrared receiving port receives position and direction data of the mobile robot. The mobile robot includes an infrared receiving port(3), and an infrared transmitting port(4). The infrared receiving port in the mobile robot receives the position basis data and guide data from the charging unit. The infrared transmitting port(4) in the mobile robot transmits position and direction data to the charging unit. Thus, the mobile robot docks with the charging unit quickly and precisely by data communication between the mobile robot and the charging unit.
source_title: DOCKING SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR MOBILE ROBOT

abstract: This document describes neuromorphic controllers. In one aspect, a method for controlling one or more joints of a robotic arm includes receiving, by neuromorphic controller comprising a spiking neural network (SNN), a target value of a joint control variable for a joint of the robotic arm. The SNN includes two position proprioceptor neurons, two-speed proprioceptor neurons, a presynaptic inhibitory neuron, an extensor motor neuron, and a flexor motor neuron. The neuromorphic controller updates an actual value of the joint control variable for the joint of the robotic arm based on the target value of the joint control variable. The updating includes generating, by one of the two position proprioceptor neurons, the first spikes to one of the extensors motor neurons or the flexor motor neuron based on a difference between the actual value of the joint control variable and the target value of the joint control variable.
source_title: NEUROMORPHIC SMOOTH CONTROL OF ROBOTIC ARMS

abstract: A tool engagement coupler configured to deliver a tool at a working position on a workpiece, the tool engagement coupler further being moveable by a robotic arm to engage with a locator at the working position. The tool engagement coupler includes an engagement member having a first predetermined shape adapted to engage with the locator having a second predetermined shape. The tool engagement coupler is adapted to be moved by the robotic arm based on a decreasing level of spatial tolerance as the engagement member approaches the locator based at least in part on the first predetermined shape and the second predetermined shape.
source_title: A TOOL ENGAGEMENT COUPLING AND ASSOCIATIED METHOD

abstract: A method includes: maintaining data handling settings at a mobile robot; generating operational data at the mobile robot, the operational data defining a current state of the mobile robot; storing the operational data in a memory of the mobile robot; selecting, based on the data handling settings, a portion of the operational data; transmitting the selected portion of the operational data; in response to a determination that the operational data meets a condition, obtaining updated data handling settings; and selecting a subsequent portion of the operational data for transmission according to the updated data handling settings.
source_title: Dynamic Control of Operational Data Handling Settings in Mobile Robots

abstract: The invention relates to a system and method for a robotic system with object handling. A computing system includes at least one processing circuit in communication with a robot having a robotic arm including or attached to an end effector device. An object processing environment is provided including an object source for delivery to a destination. At least one processing circuit identifies a target object from among the plurality of objects in the object source, determines an approach trajectory of the robotic arm and the end effector device approaching the plurality of objects, determines a gripping operation for gripping the target object with the end effector device, and controlling the robotic arm and the end effector device to traverse through the determined trajectory and pick up the target object. At least one processing circuit determines a destination approach trajectory and controls the robot arm and the end effector device that grasp the target object to approach the destination and release the target object into the destination.
source_title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR ROBOTIC SYSTEMS WITH OBJECT PROCESSING

abstract: The present invention relates to a mobile robot overcoming narrow space using a negative Poisson structure. More specifically, the mobile robot overcoming narrow space using a negative Poisson structure comprises: a first and a second plate separated to the left and right; a plurality of link blocks installed between the first and second plates and having a degree of freedom by a negative Poisson structure; an operating unit installed on one side of the first plate and connected to a rod on one side of the second plate to simultaneously change the width and length of the link blocks; and a moving unit having a motor underneath the first and second plates. The size of the robot is adjusted in accordance with narrow spaces of various widths by using the negative Poisson structure to move freely in narrow spaces to perform work in place of a worker at disaster and collapse sites and industrial sites. The mobile robot can move freely forward/backward and to the left/right by using a mecanum wheel. An environment recognition algorithm is applied to determine whether the mobile robot passes narrow terrain and calculate the distance to automatically adjust the size of the link blocks.
source_title: A mobile robot overcoming narrow space using negative poisson structure

abstract: A solar panel dispensing device comprising a hopper and a robotic arm. The hopper includes a base and a frame defining an interior volume and being configured to contain solar panels therein supported in an upright position. The robotic arm is moveable about the hopper in one or more degrees of freedom. The robotic arm includes a solar panel end effector operable to acquire a lead solar panel oriented in the upright orientation. The solar panel end effector includes an interfacing orientation and a release orientation; The robotic arm further includes an arm actuator operable to move the robotic arm and the solar panel end effector between the interfacing orientation and the release orientation. The interfacing orientation and the release orientation of the solar panel end effector correspond respectively to the solar panel being in the upright orientation, and the solar panel being in a presentation orientation.
source_title: Solar panel dispensing device with vertical solar panel hopper loading and dispensing

abstract: The invention relates to a system for processing a ground at least partially in an outdoor region, in particular removing dirt or grass cuttings, comprising a base station (6) and a mobile robot unit (8). The technical problem of improving the operating results of a mobile robot unit while simultaneously improving operating safety, is solved in that at least one detection means (24) for detecting at least one environmental variable is provided, and in that a controller (34) is provided which influences the operating mode of the mobile robot unit (8) in accordance with the value of at least one of the environmental variables detected by the at least one detection means (24). The invention further relates to a method for controlling a mobile robot unit for processing a ground at least partially in an outdoor region, in particular removing dirt or grass cuttings.
source_title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR PROCESSING A GROUND WITH A MOBILE ROBOT UNIT

abstract: The invention discloses an arbitrary curve path tracking method. The arbitrary curve path tracking method comprises the following steps: (1) conducting two-degree-of-freedom and three-degree-of-freedom planning switching on a vehicle model; (2) conducting path planning: conducting path segmentation, conducting control point selection, conducting high-order spline curve fitting, and updating and combining paths; and (3) calculating the speed and angular speed output according to a path planned in the step (2) and a current real-time pose. On the premise of random generation of stations, a mobile robot can fit the high-order spline curve path according to a station generation sequence and calculate the correct speed and angular speed output according to the path and the current pose, so that tracking of a curve by the robot is guaranteed; and calculation is simpler, and an AGV runs more flexibly.
source_title: Arbitrary curve path tracking method

abstract: A continuous risk assessment system for mobile robots (10), the system comprising: at least one robot monitor (100), configured to monitor the environment of the mobile robot (10) and send sensor data representative of the robot's environment to a computing server (300), the robot monitor (100) comprising a central processing unit (107) configured to receive sensor data from at least one sensor (101-106) installed on the robot (10); the computing server (300), configured to collect and store sensor data received from the at least one robot monitor (100) and to perform the robot's operation risk assessment by means of an artificial intelligence (AI) data processing module (303) trained based on historical data of the robot's operation to generate hazard information relevant to safety guidelines; the user interface module (200) configured to provide a graphical user interface (GUI) for user interaction with the system, allowing input of the safety guidelines and presenting the hazard information.
source_title: A CONTINUOUS RISK ASSESSMENT SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR MOBILE ROBOTS

abstract: An autonomous mobile robot according to various embodiments of the present disclosure may include: a main body; a support frame disposed under the main body to support the main body; a suspension module including a first suspension module disposed in a first area of the bottom surface of the support frame and a second suspension module disposed in a second area different from the first area; a driving module connected to the first suspension module and providing a driving force to the mobile robot; a plurality of caster modules connected to the second suspension module and capable of rotating; and a rigid member coupled with the plurality of caster modules and the support frame, and providing a restoring force for preventing departure of the horizontal surface formed by the plurality of caster modules when the mobile robot is traveling.
source_title: MOBILE ROBOT INCLUDING A SUSPENSION MODULE

abstract: The invention discloses a robot vision tracking control system and method based on wearable vision. The robot vision tracking control system comprises a master-end wearable teleoperation control device and a slave-end robot, wherein the master-end wearable teleoperation control device is used for remotely transmitting a control instruction to the slave-end robot through a gesture, receiving data collected by the slave-end robot, and executing a gesture recognition algorithm and a target tracking algorithm; the slave-end robot is configured to receive the control instruction, execute a corresponding action according to the control instruction, and return the collected data to the master-end wearable teleoperation control device; and the master-end wearable teleoperation control device comprises a wearable camera and a head-mounted display module and is used for collecting gesture images and displaying the data collected by the slave-end robot and the motion trail of the gesture controlinstruction. According to the wearable control system, an operator can conveniently control a mobile robot vehicle-mounted reconnaissance system to rapidly aim at a target and track the target throughthe gestures.
source_title: Robot vision tracking control system and method based on wearable vision

abstract: A mobile robot includes a driver configured to provide a traveling function, a body disposed at an upper side of the driver, a concave portion recessed inward from a surface of the body, a vent hole formed at an upper side of the concave portion, and a guide inclined surface formed at a lower side of the concave portion. During traveling of the mobile robot, the mobile robot induces inflow of air so that the body can be cooled.
source_title: Mobile robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a foldable movable device for the treatment of products. The device includes a structure having a base, a framework and panels, where the framework is upwardly fixed to the base and the panels being mounted to the framework. The device further includes an automation, fixed to the structure, that comprises a robotic arm and a tool, fixed at the robotic arm, that is suitable for gripping the products. The panels are articulately mounted on the framework, in order to be moved from a folded configuration of the device to a deployed configuration, and reversely.
source_title: FOLDABLE MOVABLE UNIT FOR TREATMENT OF PRODUCTS

abstract: The invention relates to a rescue method and rescue system for a mobile robot. The rescue method comprises the steps that S1, a robot dispatching system judges whether the mobile robot breaks down or not according to state information sent to the robot dispatching system in the operation process of the mobile robot; if the mobile robot breaks down, the rescue robot moves to the position near the faulted mobile robot according to state information provided by the robot dispatching system, and whether the faulted mobile robot is in a normal posture or not is judged; if the fault mobile robot is in an abnormal pose, requesting manual rescue; if the fault mobile robot is in the normal posture, the rescue robot restarts the system of the fault mobile robot, and if the fault of the fault mobile robot is eliminated, the mobile robot continues to run; otherwise, the rescue robot consignes the fault mobile robot to a maintenance point for maintenance. According to the invention, a comprehensive rescue scheme is provided for different fault types.
source_title: Rescue method and rescue system of mobile robot

abstract: The present invention relates to a robotic gripper, comprising: a frame (100), at least two finger units (20) that are provided on the frame (100) and grasping an object, wherein each of the finger units (20) comprising: at least a pair of parallel linkage mechanisms, wherein each of the parallel linkage mechanism comprising a first link (200), a second link (201), a third link (202), a linear movable platform (203), and a finger frame (301), the mechanism that aims to move the finger frame (301) in a straight line or a substantially straight line, and that have the capability of moving to either of sides with respect to the direction along the stroke of the linear movable platform (203) to provide a wide working range for the gripper, the linear movable platform (203) comprising one or more slidable bearings (204) that is slidable along one or more shafts (205), respectively, wherein the linear sliding stroke along one or more shafts (205) is configured to be so as to each of the shafts (205) is aligned or nearly aligned to the other end of the first link (200) located on the frame (100). In addition, the present invention relates to a robotic arm and a robot comprising the gripper.
source_title: A ROBOTIC GRIPPER, A ROBOT ARM AND A ROBOT COMPRISING THE SAME

abstract: A system and method of autonomously navigating an autonomous robot is described. The described method involves creating a topological mapping of an area of environment around a location of the mobile robot; identifying at least one pathway around the location; and locally constraining a motion of the mobile robot based on the topological mapping and the identified at least pathway. The method expects inaccuracies in the localization to happen within an acceptable range and mitigates these errors by locally constraining the motion of the robot or vehicle to what is defined safe upon an analysis of data perceived through one or more robot sensors.
source_title: SYSTEM, METHOD AND NON-TRANSITORY COMPUTER-READABLE STORAGE DEVICE FOR AUTONOMOUS NAVIGATION OF AUTONOMOUS ROBOT

abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of robot movement control, and particularly relates to a mobile robot autonomous obstacle avoidance method, which comprises the following steps: establishing a movement model of a mobile robot, sampling the speed of the mobile robot, and carrying out track calculation on the mobile robot on the basis of acquiring the speed; based on a binocular vision system loaded on the mobile robot, an obstacle in the track direction of the mobile robot is detected, and three-dimensional information of the obstacle is output; and according to the three-dimensional information of the obstacle and the current attitude information of the mobile robot, controlling the mobile robot to execute obstacle avoidance operation corresponding to the three-dimensional information and the attitude information. The invention further provides an autonomous obstacle avoidance system of the mobile robot. The obstacle can be accurately detected, so that obstacle avoidance is conveniently realized, and the obstacle avoidance efficiency and the obstacle avoidance success rate of the robot are effectively improved.
source_title: Autonomous obstacle avoidance method and system for mobile robot

abstract: In a legged mobile robot having at least a body and a plurality of legs each connected to the body through a first joint and a foot each connected to a distal end of each of the legs through a second joint, a floor reaction force detector is installed between the second joint and a contact end of the foot. More specifically, an upper portion of the floor reaction force detector is connected at a location near the second joint, and the contact end of the foot or thereabout is constituted by a spring mechanism that is lower in rigidity than a member constituting the second joint or thereabout such that a lower portion of the floor reaction force detector is connected to the contact end through the spring mechanism. With this, it becomes possible to provide the floor reaction force detector that can improve detection accuracy of the floor reaction force and prevent the performance of control from being degraded, while enabling to maintain a stable posture during standing and to decrease the impact at foot landing. <IMAGE>
source_title: FLOOR REACTION DETECTOR OF LEGGED MOBILE ROBOT

abstract: Disclosed in a robotic arm with vibration detection and image recognition, of which a main structure includes a wafer transportation device, a robotic arm rotatably mounted on the wafer transportation device, an image acquiring device arranged on the robotic arm, at least one first vibration detector arranged on the robotic arm, a second vibration detector arranged in an interior of the wafer transportation device, and a monitoring device arranged at one side of the wafer transportation device. The monitoring device includes a status inspecting part in information connection with the image acquiring device and a vibration inspecting part in information connection with the first vibration detector and the second vibration detector. By means of the above structure, the robotic arm is additionally provided with functions of wafer storage status inspecting, impact sensing, and lifespan predicting, so as to prevent mutual influence between machine structure operation instability and inspection error.
source_title: ROBOTIC ARM WITH VIBRATION DETECTION AND IMAGE RECOGNITION

abstract: A method for controlling a mobile robot 50 capable of carrying out an operation within an environment comprises storing an environment map including data to enable the robot to navigate the environment in a memory, further storing in the memory data corresponding to one or more hazard areas encountered by the mobile robot during previous operations and reducing a tilt threshold of the robot when the mobile robot is navigating within an area 60 that corresponds to a previously encountered hazard area. The memory may be onboard the mobile robot. The or each hazard area may be an area where the mobile robot has previously experienced a hazard event such as becoming stuck. The operation carried out by the mobile robot in the environment may be a cleaning operation such as vacuuming or sweeping a floor and the hazard area data may be updated if the mobile robot encounters a new hazard while carrying out the operation.
source_title: A mobile robot and method of controlling thereof

abstract: The invention discloses a mobile robot online path planning method based on an improved DQN algorithm, and the method comprises the following specific steps: improving a DQN neural network model, and adding an action value evaluation network e to assist a Q network in selecting actions. Matrix information which is obtained by processing overall environment picture information and contains four kinds of pixel information serves as state information S of a robot, and the state information S is input into a Q network and an e network; in consideration of a general path planning problem, a two-dimensional grid map used in each time of training adopts a random generation mode; the experience playback pool is composed of two playback pools with different priorities, and different proportions are adopted to extract experiences in different training stages according to different training targets; aiming at a method for training network parameters of the DQN main network, adopting a fractional gradient descent algorithm added with a momentum item; the method is used for solving the problems of low success rate, low convergence speed and the like when the conventional DQN is used for robot path planning.
source_title: Mobile robot online path planning method based on improved DQN algorithm

abstract: The present invention relates to a modular mobile robot capable of providing various services and autonomous driving. Further, a modular mobile robot according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a body; a driving unit mounted on the lower end of the body to enable the body to move; a module coupling plate mounted on the upper end of the body and having an upper surface on which a carried object is disposed; a porter module coupled to the upper surface of the module coupling plate to fix the carried object, and providing module information to the module coupling plate; a body display unit formed to extend in a vertical direction from one end of the module coupling plate; a head display unit rotatably mounted on the upper end of the body display unit; and a control unit for receiving module information provided from the module coupling plate, and controlling at least one of the body display unit and the head display unit on the basis of the provided module information.
source_title: MODULAR MOBILE ROBOT COMPRISING PORTER MODULE

abstract: A mobile robot with a chassis including one or more drive mechanisms and at least a first arm pivotably connected to the chassis and configured to pitch up and down. A ski structure is attached on an underside of the first arm for raising the chassis as the arm is pitched down so the drive mechanisms can traverse a riser in the path of the chassis.
source_title: Stair assist robot mechanism and method

abstract: Disclosed are a device and a method for controlling an autonomous mobile robot using an image position system. The device for controlling an autonomous mobile robot according to one embodiment comprises: a communication part performing communication with an autonomous mobile robot (AMR); and a control part connected to the communication part, wherein the control part receives image information from the autonomous mobile robot through the communication part, generates position information of the autonomous mobile robot based on the image information using a visual positioning system (VPS), and enables the VPS to be trained based on the image information and the position information.
source_title: Apparatus and method for controlling autonomous mobile robots

abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of path planning, and provides a path planning method, terminal equipment and a computer readable storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining at least one first path existing in an environment where a plurality of first mobile robots are located, the first path represents a path applied in a path planning process of any one of the plurality of first mobile robots; and planning a second path of a second mobile robot according to the first path, wherein the second mobile robot is any one of the plurality of first mobile robots. According to the method, paths corresponding to a plurality of mobile devices can be quickly generated in a complex dynamic environment, and higher timeliness is shown.
source_title: Path planning method, terminal equipment and computer readable storage medium

abstract: The invention provides a kinematics parameter calibration method of a multi-degree-of-freedom robotic arm. The kinematics parameter calibration method comprises the following steps: fitting a first rotating shaft axis and a second rotating shaft axis; establishing a mechanical arm base coordinate system according to the first rotating shaft axis and the second rotating shaft axis; fitting the axis of the third rotating shaft to obtain the two-shaft connecting rod length; fitting the fourth rotating shaft axis to obtain the length of the three-axis connecting rod and the offset of the fourth rotating shaft axis relative to the second rotating shaft axis; fitting the axis of the fifth rotating shaft to obtain the length of the four-shaft connecting rod and the offset of the axis of the fifth rotating shaft relative to the axis of the fourth rotating shaft; fitting the axis of the sixth rotating shaft to obtain the length of the five-axis connecting rod and the offset of the axis of the sixth rotating shaft relative to the axis of the fourth rotating shaft.
source_title: Kinematics parameter calibration method of multi-degree-of-freedom mechanical arm

abstract: A method of localizing a mobile robot 100 with respect to a target object 601 using an initial map of a reference object which is a representation of the target object is disclosed herein.
